column1: # Lelievlet - SPANTENLIJST (frame / offset table)
# Source: Vademecum voor het waterwerk
#         page 22 (PDF page 22) -> vademecum_pages/vademecum_p22.png
# Transcribed by eye from the scan. VERIFY against the page image before use.
# Columns:
#   station_mm        = the number printed at the left of each row (365..5365
#                       Longitudinal position measured from the SPIEGEL (transom) FORWARD.
#                       The datum is not printed on p22 itself; it is established by three
#                       independent cross-checks (see SOURCES.md section 2):
#                        - p23 carries a "365" dimension from the aft end to station 0 and a
#                          "245" dimension from station 10 to the stem (365+5000+245 = 5610 ~ LOA)
#                        - the meetrapport chain from Punt 0 (back of mastkoker) puts the forward
#                          bulkhead at 3759 mm from the transom; p25 states 3750 mm
#                        - spant 6 is the max-beam frame (913 x 2 = 1826)
#                          item 22 "Breedte t.p.v. spant 6 op berghouthoogte 1822-1830"
#                       So: spant 0 = 365 mm fwd of the transom
#   spant_no          = frame number 0..10 as drawn on the body plan above the table
#   boeisel_height    = "BOVENKANT BOEISEL - HOOGTE uit BASIS" (mm above baseline)
#   boeisel_halfbeam  = "BOVENKANT BOEISEL - 1/2 BREEDTE" (mm from centreline)
#   berghout_height   = "BERGHOUT - HOOGTE uit BASIS"
#   berghout_halfbeam = "BERGHOUT - 1/2 BREEDTE"   (this is the max beam line; spant 6 = 913 -> 1826 total)
#   onderkant_huid_height   = "ONDERKANT HUID - HOOGTE uit BASIS"  (chine: vlak/kim seam)
#   onderkant_huid_halfbeam = "ONDERKANT HUID - 1/2 BREEDTE"
#   kiel_height       = "KIEL - HOOGTE uit BASIS" (centreline of the bottom; 0 at spant 6)
# Body plan also carries: half-breadth 1750 at boeisel level and 1790 at berghout level
# (i.e. max beam over berghout 1790 mm) - see the two dimensions at top right of p22.
station_mm
